newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Umax to issue T$6/share dividend.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Umax to issue T$6/share dividend.

text.p: Taiwan computer and image scanner maker Umax Data Systems Inc said on Sunday shareholders have approved a stock dividend, or bonus issue of T$6 per share for 1996.
In the meeting on Saturday, shareholders also agreed to a rights issue of T$300 million, or 30 million shares, it said in a statement.
The rights issue would be used to buy machinery and equipment, pay back bank loans and add operating funds, it said.
Ten percent of the rights issue will be offered to the public, and shareholders would authorise the board directors to launch the issue at an appropriate time, it said.
Umax made a pre-tax profit of T$647 million on sales of T$6.3 billion in 1996, up 97 percent and 73 percent, respectively, over 1995, it said.
The company has set a 1997 sales target of T$15.3 billion, a 142 percent rise from 1996, it said. It did not give its profit forecast for 1997.
